tool.name: FLASHDeconv
tool.description: Ultra-fast high-quality deconvolution enables online processing of top-down MS data
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in && cp '$in' 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' && mkdir out && #if "out_spec1_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_spec1 && #end if #if "out_spec2_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_spec2 && #end if #if "out_spec3_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_spec3 && #end if #if "out_spec4_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_spec4 && #end if #if "out_mzml_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_mzml && #end if #if "out_quant_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_quant && #end if #if "out_annotated_mzml_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_annotated_mzml && #end if #if "out_msalign1_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_msalign1 && #end if #if "out_msalign2_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_msalign2 && #end if #if "out_feature1_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_feature1 && #end if #if "out_feature2_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_feature2 && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' -out 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #if "out_spec1_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_spec1 'out_spec1/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #end if #if "out_spec2_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_spec2 'out_spec2/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #end if #if "out_spec3_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_spec3 'out_spec3/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #end if #if "out_spec4_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_spec4 'out_spec4/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #end if #if "out_mzml_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_mzml 'out_mzml/output.${gxy2omsext("mzml")}' #end if #if "out_quant_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_quant 'out_quant/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #end if #if "out_annotated_mzml_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_annotated_mzml 'out_annotated_mzml/output.${gxy2omsext("mzml")}' #end if #if "out_msalign1_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_msalign1 'out_msalign1/output.${gxy2omsext("txt")}' #end if #if "out_msalign2_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_msalign2 'out_msalign2/output.${gxy2omsext("txt")}' #end if #if "out_feature1_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_feature1 'out_feature1/output.${gxy2omsext("txt")}' #end if #if "out_feature2_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_feature2 'out_feature2/output.${gxy2omsext("txt")}' #end if #if len(str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',')) == 0 | tee '$stdout' #end if
## Postprocessing && mv 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out' #if "out_spec1_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_spec1/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out_spec1' #end if #if "out_spec2_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_spec2/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out_spec2' #end if #if "out_spec3_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_spec3/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out_spec3' #end if #if "out_spec4_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_spec4/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out_spec4' #end if #if "out_mzml_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_mzml/output.${gxy2omsext("mzml")}' '$out_mzml' #end if #if "out_quant_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_quant/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out_quant' #end if #if "out_annotated_mzml_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_annotated_mzml/output.${gxy2omsext("mzml")}' '$out_annotated_mzml' #end if #if "out_msalign1_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_msalign1/output.${gxy2omsext("txt")}' '$out_msalign1' #end if #if "out_msalign2_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_msalign2/output.${gxy2omsext("txt")}' '$out_msalign2' #end if #if "out_feature1_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_feature1/output.${gxy2omsext("txt")}' '$out_feature1' #end if #if "out_feature2_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_feature2/output.${gxy2omsext("txt")}' '$out_feature2' #end if #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.label: Input file in mzML format.
param.help: select mzml data sets(s)

param.label: Retain empty output files
param.help: (e.g., *.tsv files with no features)

param.label: Include detailed peak information (m/z, intensity, charge, isotope index) for each deconvolved mass in the output spectrum tsv files specified by out_spec* options

param.name: ida_log
param.label: Provide the log file generated by FLASHIda
param.help: (e.g., IDA*.log) for coupling with FLASHIda acquisition

param.name: report_FDR
param.label: Generate q-values (approximate FDR) for deconvolved masses
param.help: Decoy masses are also reported which were used for FDR calculation. (Beta version)

param.name: allowed_isotope_error
param.label: Tolerance for isotope index errors when calculating FDR
param.help: For instance, setting a value of 2 permits the inclusion of up to 2 isotope errors as valid matches. Beta version

param.name: use_RNA_averagine
param.label: Use the RNA (nucleotide) averagine model for deconvolution

param.name: precursor_MS1_window
param.label: Number of MS1 spectra around each MS2 spectrum to search for precursor peaks when determining the MS2 precursors
param.help: For MS2 spectrum, the mass of precursor ion should be determined for better deconvolution and reliable identification. If the mass of precursor ion is not found in the immediately preceding MS1 spectrum, previous or next MS1 spectra may be used instead. This parameter determines up to how many MS1 spectra around each MS2 spectrum will be searched

param.name: isolation_window
param.label: Specify the isolation window width for precursor determination
param.help: Used when this information is absent in the mzML file

param.name: merging_method
param.label: Method for merging spectra before deconvolution
param.help: 0: No merging 1: Gaussian averaging per MS level, effective for Q-TOF datasets. For MSn (n > 1), only the spectra from the same precursor mass (subject to tolerance set by SD:tol) are averaged. 2: Block merging, combining all spectra into one per MS level (e.g., for NativeMS datasets)

param.name: merging_min_ms_level
param.label: Min MS level for merging

param.name: merging_max_ms_level
param.label: Max MS level for merging

param.name: tol
param.label: PPM Tolerance for MS1, 2, ...: Specify the tolerance values in parts per million (ppm) using the this option
param.help: For example, -tol 10.0 5.0 sets the tolerance to 10.0 ppm for MS1 and 5.0 ppm for MS2. If a negative value (e.g., -1) is provided, the tolerance will be estimated automatically by a tolerance estimation algorithm (space separated list, in order to allow for spaces in list items surround them by single quotes)

param.name: min_mass
param.label: Minimum mass (Da)

param.name: max_mass
param.label: Maximum mass (Da)

param.name: min_charge
param.label: Minimum charge state for MS1 spectra (can be negative for negative mode)
param.help: For MSn (n > 1), minimum charge is fixed to 1

param.name: max_charge
param.label: Maximum charge state for spectra (can be negative for negative mode)
param.help: Apart from min_charge, this option applies to all MS levels

param.name: precursor_charge
param.label: Charge state of the target precurso
param.help: All precursor charge for MSn (n > 1) is fixed to this value. When precursor m/z is provided within the input mzML file or is specified using precursor_mz option, precursor mass is calculated accordingly

param.name: precursor_mz
param.label: Target precursor m/z value
param.help: This option must be used in combination with the -precursor_charge option; otherwise, it will be ignored. If the -precursor_charge option is specified but this option is not, the precursor m/z value from the input mzML file will be used as the default

param.name: min_cos
param.label: Cosine similarity thresholds between avg
param.help: and observed isotope pattern for MS1, 2, ...: e.g., -min_cos 0.3 0.6 to specify 0.3 and 0.6 for MS1 and MS2, respectively (space separated list, in order to allow for spaces in list items surround them by single quotes)

expand.name: min_cos

validator.message: a space separated list of float values in the range 0.5:1.0 is required

expand.validator: len(value.split(' ')) == len([_ for _ in value.split(' ') if 0.5 <= float(_) <= 1.0])

param.name: min_snr
param.label: Minimum charge SNR (the SNR of the isotope pattern of a specific charge) thresholds for MS1, 2, ...:
param.help: e.g., -min_snr 1.0 0.6 to specify 1.0 and 0.6 for MS1 and MS2, respectively (space separated list, in order to allow for spaces in list items surround them by single quotes)

expand.name: min_snr

validator.message: a space separated list of float values in the range 0.25: is required

expand.validator: len(value.split(' ')) == len([_ for _ in value.split(' ') if 0.25 <= float(_)])

param.name: mass_error_ppm
param.label: Specifies the mass error tolerance for feature tracing in ppm
param.help: When negative, the MS1 tolerance for deconvolution is used (e.g., 16 ppm is used when -SD:tol 16)

param.name: ion_mobility_tolerance
param.label: Allowed ion mobility deviation (in 1/K0 units
param.help: e.g., 0.01-0.05). For CCS data, use larger values (e.g., 2-10 square angstroms)

param.name: quant_method
param.label: Method of quantification for mass traces
param.help: For LC data 'area' is recommended, 'median' for direct injection data. 'max_height' simply uses the most intense peak in the trace

param.name: min_sample_rate
param.label: Minimum fraction of scans along the feature trace that must contain a peak
param.help: To raise feature detection sensitivity, lower this value close to 0

param.name: min_trace_length
param.label: Minimum expected length of a mass trace (in seconds)
param.help: Only for MS1 (or minimum MS level in the dataset) feature tracing. For MSn, all traces are kept regardless of this value

param.name: max_trace_length
param.label: Maximum expected length of a mass trace (in seconds)
param.help: Set to a negative value to disable maximal length check during mass trace detection

param.name: min_cos
param.label: Cosine similarity threshold between avg
param.help: and observed isotope pattern. When negative, MS1 cosine threshold for spectral deconvolution (set by -SD:min_cos will be used

param.name: type
param.label: Specifies the isobaric quantification method used in the experiment

param.name: isotope_correction
param.label: Enable isotope correction (highly recommended)

param.name: reporter_mz_tol
param.label: Specifies the m/z tolerance (in Th) for reporter ion detection

param.name: only_fully_quantified
param.label: Restricts analysis to spectra that are fully quantified, meaning all channels have non-zero intensity reporter ions
Charge state of deconvolved masses in mzML output specified by -out_mzml
Specify the minimum m/z values for peaks considered during deconvolution
param.help: Negative values disable the threshold

param.label: Specify the maximum m/z values for peaks considered during deconvolution
param.help: Negative values disable the threshold

param.label: Specify the minimum retention time (in minutes) for spectra considered during deconvolution
param.help: Negative values disable the threshold

param.label: Specify the maximum retention time (in minutes) for spectra considered during deconvolution
param.help: Negative values disable the threshold

param.label: Set the maximum MS level (inclusive) for deconvolution
param.help: Negative values disable the threshold

param.label: Overrides tool-specific checks
Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

param.name: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS
param.label: Optional outputs
param.option: out_spec1 (Output tsv file for deconvolved MS1 spectra)
out_spec2 (Output TSV files for deconvolved MS2 spectra)
out_spec3 (Output TSV files for deconvolved MS3 spectra)
out_spec4 (Output TSV files for deconvolved MS4 spectra)
out_mzml (Output mzML file containing deconvolved spectra (for all MS levels))
out_quant (Output tsv file with isobaric quantification results for MS2 spectra)
out_annotated_mzml (Output annotated mzML file with monoisotopic mass, charge, and isotope index metadata for peaks)
out_msalign1 (Output msalign (TopFD and ProMex compatible) file for MS1 deconvolved spectra)
out_msalign2 (Output msalign (TopFD and ProMex compatible) file for MS2 deconvolved spectra)
out_feature1 (Output feature file (TopFD compatible) for MS1 spectra)
out_feature2 (Output feature file (TopFD compatible) for MS2 spectra)

data.name: out_spec1
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_spec1
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_spec1_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_spec2
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_spec2
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_spec2_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_spec3
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_spec3
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_spec3_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_spec4
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_spec4
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_spec4_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_mzml
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_mzml
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_mzml_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_quant
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_quant
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_quant_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_annotated_mzml
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_annotated_mzml
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_annotated_mzml_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_msalign1
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_msalign1
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_msalign1_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_msalign2
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_msalign2
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_msalign2_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_feature1
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_feature1
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_feature1_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_feature2
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_feature2
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_feature2_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: ctd_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ctd
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "ctd_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

tool.help:
Ultra-fast high-quality deconvolution enables online processing of top-down MS data
For more information, visit https://www.openms.de/doxygen/release/3.6.0/html/TOPP_FLASHDeconv.html
